dedupe_keys.name: niger basin authority abn monthly hydrological bulletins and hydrological information system

description: The Niger Basin Authority (ABN), the intergovernmental body of the Niger River basin with its executive secretariat in Niamey, publishes monthly hydrological bulletins as PDF files in its resource centre under surface water management; on 27 September 2026 the list included bulletins for February to May 2024 among others, each with its size, download count and date added. The site also links to an access page for hydrological data, agro-meteorological data, forecasts, the environmental information system, satellite monitoring of flows, the hydrological information system and satellite altimetry. Coverage is the Niger River basin. Access is online and free as downloadable bulletins. Caveats: the bulletins are documents, not data tables, and the hydrological information system was not opened. Simulation uses: river flow situation and outlooks for flood and drought exposure of dams, irrigation schemes and riverside assets in the basin. Related records: Mekong River Commission portal (data-mrc-mekong-river-commission-data-portal) and Kariba lake levels (data-zra-kariba-lake-levels-reservoir-river-flows).
